from datetime import date

from shop.hires import Hire, may_borrow, open_db


def test_may_borrow(tmp_path):
    db = open_db(tmp_path / "shop.db")
    db.execute("insert into customers values (1, 0), (2, 1)")
    assert may_borrow(db, Hire(1, 1, date(2026, 1, 1)), date(2026, 1, 5))
    assert not may_borrow(db, Hire(1, 1, date(2026, 1, 1)), date(2026, 1, 12))
    assert may_borrow(db, Hire(2, 2, date(2026, 1, 1)), date(2026, 1, 12))
    assert db.execute("select count(*) from customers").fetchone()[0] == 2
